title: MaleTheme Solo #004 · 남 맨즈 피지크·그래픽 블랙·뱀파이어 테마·메탈릭
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult French man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, fair skin with a faint rosy undertone, a cool composed look, soft pastel-peach hair styled in half-up, top section lifted with the length flowing loose below, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted diamond drop, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (an iron square-sided cowbell, a gold cube-shaped block, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single silver ring. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a long black cape lined in red silk, fastened at his neck and hanging open down his back, leaving the front of his body bare, and a minimal mirror-polished metallic black satin T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform stiletto corset-lace boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
